args.body: Resume BUYER-REQUEST-BILINGUAL-DOCUMENTATION under a valid lease. Check the committed inventory and actual feed receipt first. Reuse an equivalent result if present. A feed failure applies to that source only. If saved evidence identifies a qualifying open paid request within the original two-notice limit, produce the short bilingual sample mapped to its acceptance criterion and verify it offline. If the bounded check is exhausted without a qualifying request, save the specific exclusion or coverage gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, registration or spending.
